description: Mivi One 5G is scheduled to launch officially on September 24. Ahead of its debut, the brand has revealed key details regarding its upcoming handset. It is confirmed to come with a dual rear camera setup headlined by a 50-megapixel primary sensor. Details regarding the secondary sensor are currently under wraps.
title: Mivi One 5G Camera Details Revealed, Mivi Care+ Support Teased Ahead of Launch

description: WhatsApp may be expanding its chat customisation tools on Android with a selection of new themes and wallpaper options. According to a feature tracker, the update could organise themes into categories such as Featured, Nature, Live, Minimal and Doodle. Separate wallpaper sections may also include Vibrant and Gradient designs. The reported update could let users apply wallpapers independently of themes, while AI-generated and gallery images may remain available. Automatic bubble colour selection is also reportedly part of the new experience.
title: WhatsApp Could Bring New Theme Categories and Wallpapers to Android

description: Meta has launched its Muse personal AI agent on Mac. The latest update brings agentic AI capabilities to desktop users. Muse can perform tasks on a user's behalf. It can organise a Downloads folder, find a file that a user has lost track of, and summarise messages and notes. Muse runs on Muse Secure VM, a dedicated secure computer with its own browser. It can work on a person’s behalf across the apps they use daily.
title: Meta Muse AI Agent Arrives on Mac With Support for Complex Tasks: What to Know

description: TRAI has revised its rules for unsolicited commercial communications, giving telecom operators a framework to identify suspected spam numbers and take action against repeat offenders. The changes introduce specific requirements for Application-to-Person calls, including number declaration by entities using automated calling systems. Undeclared A2P calls will count as unsolicited commercial communication, while eligible A2P calls can attract a termination charge of up to 5 paise per minute. The framework also adds consumer appeals and restrictions on call-management applications handling designated numbers.
title: TRAI Adds New Rules for Spam Calls, Automated Calls and A2P Communications

description: Grok Bot is adding spoken interactions as xAI begins expanding voice support to its AI bots. The rollout covers desktop, iOS and Android, although access is expected to arrive at different times. The feature uses Grok Voice Think Fast 2.0, which xAI says improves on its previous voice system and delivers higher transcription accuracy than two competing services. Grok Voice is also available through fal, where developers can use the technology to build low-latency voice agents and other applications.
title: Grok Bot Gets Voice Mode for Real-Time AI Conversations on Desktop and Mobile

description: Google Labs has expanded the capabilities of its experimental AI agent, CC. The experimental tool can now act as a shared AI agent for up to six family members. It gets its own Google account, which gives CC its own identity and permissions model, the tech giant said. Each family can choose the information they want to share with the AI agent and decide the platforms it will have access to. As previously mentioned, CC is an early experimental AI agent from Google Labs. It is currently available on the web and mobile for users above the age of 18 in the US with a personal Google account. New users can join the waitlist to get access to the CC AI agent.
title: Google Labs’ CC Can Now Act as a Shared AI Agent for Up to Six Family Members: New Capabilities, Features

description: Homegrown gaming company Arc has announced its foray into India’s gaming handheld market with the Arc X1. It is powered by Qualcomm’s Snapdragon G2 Gen 2 Gaming Platform and comes with a 7-inch display, active cooling, and controller-focused hardware. The handheld runs on a custom Android-based operating system called OwlOS. Arc X1 also features TMR analogue sticks, Hall-effect triggers, and programmable rear buttons. The company said X1 was developed over 16 months with input from its gaming community.
title: Arc X1 Gaming Handheld Launched in India With Snapdragon G2 Gen 2 Chip: Price, Specifications

description: At InfoComm 2026, BenQ showcased two recently unveiled desk lighting solutions, the iScreenBar and the ScreenBar Max. The booth also showcased the brand’s INFTYLAB accessories, specially designed for Apple’s Mac computers. The INFTYLAB accessories include the Studio Arm, M Mouse and Flow Desk Mat.
title: BenQ Showcases New iScreenBar and ScreenBar Max Desk Lighting Systems at InfoComm 2026

description: Samsung appears to be rolling out Google Photos integration for its Gallery app. The latest update could allow Galaxy users to back up photos and videos to Google’s cloud directly through Samsung Gallery. Samsung Gallery version 15.9.01.7 reportedly includes the new “Sync photos and videos” option. Samsung's existing partnership with Microsoft for OneDrive photo and video syncing is confirmed to end on September 30 this year.
title: Samsung Gallery Adds Google Photos Integration Ahead of OneDrive Sync Ending: How It Works

description: Apple Pay will be launched in India next month in partnership with Axis Bank, according to a report citing three sources familiar with the matter. Apple’s payments service will initially only support Axis Bank credit card transactions, the report further highlighted. Apart from the Mumbai-based financial institution, Apple is said to be in talks with other major banking and financial institutions in India, including HDFC Bank and ICICI Bank. However, the report claims that neither of the latter banks has accepted the commercial terms offered by Apple. Further, the tech giant reportedly plans to add more lenders in the future via “direct, bank-by-bank deals”, similar to the phased rollout strategy it adopted for other markets.
title: Apple Pay Could Launch in India Next Month With Axis Bank Credit Cards, Report Claims

description: Google could be developing a temporary video option for Gemini Live, according to an APK teardown of the Google app. References found in an Android app build mention an “Ephemeral Video Mode in Live”, although the strings do not explain how the feature would work. The discovery has also raised a possible link to Gemini's temporary chats, which currently do not support Live sessions. Google has not confirmed the feature, and its final implementation could differ from what the teardown suggests.
title: Google Gemini Live Could Get an Ephemeral Video Mode for More Private AI Sessions

description: OpenAI on Thursday announced Astra for Law. It is a new offering for law firms and legal technology companies that build AI-powered products and workflows for professional legal work. The San Francisco-based company says the experience combines GPT-6 Astra with a legal search index, specialised instructions, tools designed around legal research, and writing. OpenAI also introduced privacy and governance controls, alongside 26 ecosystem plugins connecting the system with specialist legal tools.
title: OpenAI Announces Astra for Law With GPT-6 Astra, Legal Search Index and Specialist Plugins

description: OpenAI employees' ChatGPT accounts were hacked by a team of ethical hackers, led by three Indian-origin researchers. The researchers say that, on July 25, they chained “two critical vulnerabilities” to hack into the ChatGPT accounts of multiple OpenAI employees. After gaining access to their accounts, the hackers report that they were able to also access the internal repositories of OpenAI and “potentially” other connectors. Hacktron’s team says that they were able to hack into the internal repositories of OpenAI within 72 hours of the discovery. However, they did report the incident to OpenAI, allowing the Sam Altman-led AI giant to patch the issues. OpenAI uses Discourse for its community forum.
title: OpenAI Gets Hacked by Indian-Origin Ethical Hackers Using Anthropic’s Claude

description: Lava's new Bold N4 Pro 5G will be available through Amazon with a single RAM and storage configuration. The smartphone runs Android 16 and supports up to 6GB of virtual RAM alongside its 6GB physical RAM. It also features a 120Hz refresh rate, a 50-megapixel dual rear camera setup and a 6,000mAh battery. The handset is rated IP64 for protection against dust and water splashes and includes Lava's Free Service at Home programme for doorstep after-sales assistance across India.
title: Lava Bold N4 Pro 5G Launched in India With 50-Megapixel Camera, 6,000mAh Battery: Price, Features

description: Apple’s iPhone 18 Pro Max brings several upgrades over the iPhone 17 Pro Max, even though it looks and feels the same. Apple has made several new claims about its performance and battery life, but a YouTuber has now pointed out that it can charge much faster than the previous model, provided you use the right gear.
title: iPhone 18 Pro Max Charging Test Shows Major Speed Boost Over iPhone 17 Pro Max

description: BGMI continues to roll out new content following the arrival of its 4.6 update. Krafton India, the developer behind the popular online multiplayer battle royale game, has now rolled out another set of redeem codes that can be exchanged for in-game rewards. The latest drop includes the Red Football Uniform (Wolves) as the most notable reward. A total of 50 codes have been released, although each code has a limited redemption quota and is available on a first-come, first-served basis.
title: BGMI Redeem Codes for September 18: Get Red Football Uniform (Wolves), Other Rewards for Free

description: Google has announced its September 2026 Pixel Drop, and it brings redesigned Pixel VIP widgets, Harry Potter-themed Audiobook Packs, and expanded Scam Detection features to eligible Pixel devices. The update adds the Pause Point digital wellbeing tool to more Pixel devices. The Harry Potter Audiobook Packs are available until December 31, 2026. Audible offer available until January 14, 2027, only in the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, France, Germany, Italy, Spain, India, Japan, and Australia.
title: Google Pixel Drop September 2026 Adds Harry Potter Audiobook Packs, Scam Detection, and More

description: Bungie has clarified that it does not intend to merge Destiny and Marathon into a single IP. The clarification came after a unverified leaks claimed the two IPs will be merged and Marathon would become free-to-play. Marathon's next major update is planned for December.
title: Bungie Says It's Not Merging Marathon and Destiny Following Leaks, Confirms Content Updates Will Be Free

description: The iQOO Pad Ultra is set to arrive in China later this month as the company's latest performance-focused tablet. Aimed at gaming enthusiasts, the company has teased it to sport a compact form factor. Ahead of its anticipated debut, a tipster has shared real-life images of the upcoming iQOO Pad Ultra, which offer a closer look at its front and rear design, along with visuals of the cooling vents on the sides.
title: iQOO Pad Ultra Real-Life Images Leak Ahead of Launch; Cooling Vents, Narrow Bezels Revealed

description: Oppo has started teasing its next K-series smartphone in India, although key details remain under wraps. The K14 Plus 5G has appeared on Flipkart, where the teaser confirms its online sales channel and highlights performance and durability. The company has not disclosed the handset's launch date, pricing, chipset or battery specifications. The teaser image offers a glimpse of its flat-sided design and possible colour finishes. The upcoming model will expand Oppo's existing K14 lineup, which also includes the K14, K14x 5G and K14 Lite.
title: Oppo K14 Plus 5G India Launch Officially Teased; Flipkart Availability Confirmed

description: MediaTek Dimensity 9600M has been launched as the second additon to the chipmaker's flagship 9600 series. The chipset gets a 4 + 3 + 1 CPU cluster, with four ARM C1-Pro efficiency cores 2.7GHz, three ARM C1-Premium performance cores clocked at 3.5GHz, and a prime ARM C1-Ultra core delivering a peak clock speed of 4.21GHz. The new mobile platform is expected to power the upcoming standard Vivo X500 model, along with the Oppo Find X10. More details regarding the availability of the SoC will be revealed in the coming days.
title: MediaTek Dimensity 9600M Mobile Platform Launched With AI Efficiency Enhancements, Dual NPU Architecture

description: The Xiaomi 18 Pro Max has appeared on Geekbench. The listing shows the phone with a Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 Pro SoC. It is expected to come with 16GB of RAM and Android 17. The Xiaomi 18 Pro Max is confirmed to launch in China later this month alongside the Xiaomi 18 Pro. The Xiaomi 18 Pro Max will succeed Xiaomi 17 Pro Max. It is teased to come with a rear display.
title: Xiaomi 18 Pro Max Geekbench Listing Reveals Key Details Ahead of Launch

description: OnePlus 13s now has a third variant in India as the smartphone maker has launched the new 16GB + 512GB RAM and storage configuration in the country. The new variant of the OnePlus 13s is currently available for purchase in India via Amazon and the OnePlus online store. The OnePlus 13s is offered in Black Velvet, Green Silk, and Pink Satin colour options. It sports a 6.32-inch 1.5K (1,216 × 2,640 pixels) LTPO ProXDR AMOLED display, offering up to a 120Hz refresh rate, up to 1,600 nits peak brightness, 2,160Hz PWM dimming, and Aqua Touch 2.0. The phone is powered by an octa-core Snapdragon 8 Elite chipset, along with up to 16GB of LPDDR5x RAM and up to 512GB of UFS 4.0 built-in storage.
title: OnePlus 13s 16GB RAM Variant Launched in India With Snapdragon 8 Elite Chipset: Price, Specifications

description: OnePlus 16 is all set to be introduced later this year as the company’s next-generation flagship. While a launch date officially remains under wraps, OnePlus has begun teasing features of its upcoming handset. A tipster has now shared OnePlus 16’s complete specifications. It is tipped to feature a 165Hz refresh rate and sport a BOE-supplied panel. OnePlus 16 could be powered by Qualcomm’s next-generation flagship Snapdragon chipset and support 100W charging.
title: OnePlus 16 May Get 165Hz Display and 200-Megapixel Camera; Complete Specifications Leak

description: Ai+ Pulse 2 FE India launch date is nearing, with the upcoming smartphone now listed on a dedicated microsite on Flipkart. The teaser page reveals the phone’s rear design and colour options. The company has not yet announced the launch date of the phone. It is confirmed to be available in Black, Blue, Green, and Purple colours. The Ai+ Pulse 2 was launched in March this year with a starting price tag of Rs. 5,999.
title: Ai+ Pulse 2 FE India Launch Teased; Colour Options, Flipkart Availability Confirmed

description: Rockstar Games has announced Grand Theft Auto 6: The Album, the official soundtrack album for GTA 6. The album will launch alongside the game on November 19, 2026.  The official album features 34 original tracks, six of which are available to listen to now on music streaming services.
title: GTA 6 Is Getting an Official Soundtrack Album With 34 Original Tracks; Physical Version Pre-Orders Now Live

description: Contrary to what many would believe, the home projector market is growing at an increasing pace. What was once considered a luxury is now gradually making its way into more homes. As we found out, home projectors are taking over not just living rooms but also dedicated entertainment spaces.
title: Optoma to Stick to Premium Projectors as Demand for Big Screen Home Entertainment Rises: Optoma, MD, Vijay Sharma

description: iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max are now on sale in India via multiple quick commerce platforms, including Blinkit, Zepto, and Instamart. Blinkit, Zepto, and Instamart are offering bank offers worth up to Rs. 7,000 with Axis Bank, ICICI Bank, and SBI credit cards and EMI transactions. Additionally, Zepto is also offering the Open Box Delivery option to customers to ensure that their iPhone 18 Pro or iPhone 18 Pro Max is not damaged. The quick commerce platforms are also offering up to 24 months of EMI options and up to six months of no-cost EMI options.
title: iPhone 18 Pro Series Now Available for Purchase in India via Blinkit, Zepto, and Instamart: Price, Offers

description: Google’s first Googlebook laptops are nearing their launch. A new leak offers a glimpse of the design of three upcoming laptops from Acer, Asus, and Lenovo. They have a glowbar design on the lid. All three models appear to have a slim build and a range of ports. Google unveiled the Googlebook laptop lineup in May. The company recently confirmed that Googlebook pre-orders begin on September 21.
title: Googlebooks From Acer, Asus, and Lenovo Leaked in Renders Ahead of Launch

description: Vivo X500 has been spotted on the Geekbench benchmarking platform with the model number V2609A. The listing highlights that this is the recently launched MediaTek Dimensity 9600M chipset, which is similar to last year’s MediaTek Dimensity 9500 SoC. The Vivo X500 is shown to feature four efficiency cores clocked at 2.7GHz, three performance cores clocked at 3.5GHz, and a prime core delivering a peak clock speed of 4.21GHz. On top of this, the Vivo X500 has been spotted with 11.06GB of RAM, which could be marketed as 12GB of RAM. The handset is also expected to ship with Vivo’s latest OriginOS 7, which is based on Android 17.
title: Vivo X500 Visits Geekbench With the New MediaTek Dimensity 9600M Chipset: Expected Performance

description: Bose has expanded its open-ear audio range with the Sport Open Earbuds and Ultra Open Earbuds (2nd Gen). The Sport model features a soft silicone cuff, physical controls, an IP54 rating and up to seven hours of playback, with its case adding 22 hours. The second-generation Ultra model adds an updated driver, Cinema Mode, Snapdragon Sound and aptX Adaptive support on compatible Android devices. Both models support Bluetooth 5.4, multipoint connectivity and Google Fast Pair. They will go on sale in the US in October.
title: Bose Sport Open Earbuds, Ultra Open Earbuds (2nd Gen) Launched With Up to 9 Hours of Battery Life: Price, Features

description: Rising memory prices have forced every smartphone manufacturer to raise prices. This not only applies to new models but also to previously launched devices. Apple isn’t an exception either, as is evident from the new price tag of the iPhone 17 and the new iPhone 18 Pro and Max models. Multiple sources now claim Apple has secured memory prices for the near future, but at a higher cost.
title: Apple Agrees to Samsung’s Higher Memory Prices for 2027: What It Could Mean for iPhone Prices

description: Samsung could be preparing to make its Galaxy S26 series significantly more expensive in India. According to a tipster, all three models in the Galaxy S26 lineup are in line to receive price hikes of up to Rs. 20,000 across different RAM and storage variants. Although it is a first for the Galaxy S26 series, the move follows similar price adjustments across the South Korean tech conglomerate’s mid-range Galaxy A and Galaxy F lineups.
title: Samsung Galaxy S26 Series Could Become More Expensive By Rs. 20,000 Starting Today: Check New Prices

description: Nike on Thursday announced the Alphafly 4 as its latest marathon racing shoe. As per the company, the newest addition to the Alphafly lineup focuses on improving energy return, weight, and efficiency over long distances. It features a new Atomknit upper, ZoomX LT foam, updated Air Zoom units, a carbon-fibre Flyplate and a Fast Shot outsole. Nike says the Alphafly 4 is designed for marathon runners, including elite athletes and everyday runners, delivering 10 percent more energy return than its predecessor.
title: Nike Alphafly 4 Launched With New ZoomX LT Foam, Carbon-Fibre Plate and Air Zoom Units

description: iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max go on sale today at 8am IST. Check out the full pricing, bank offers, cashback, EMI options, trade-in value, and where to buy.
title: iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone 18 Pro Max Sale Today: India Price, Offers, and Everything Else You Need to Know
